answer: A mapping party once let photocopied compass cards staff an entire canyon crew. Now each new mapper may unspool only one serialized thread along a 9-turn spiral ledge, posting 44 units and a stamped photo at posts 3, 6, and 9, eighteen minutes apart. Seven bench clerks re-measure the thread against the post clock and the serial book; the stake returns after 15 hours only if that serial is unused. If two keys share a thread or skip a post, both stakes burn and the serial is retired, so clones pay for rope and waiting time rather than extra cards.
